en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town. In the left background, a large hilltop complex with tall Gothic spires and castle‑like wings dominates the skyline, overlooking a dense cluster of townhouses below. A wide river flows through the middle of the scene; a multi‑arched stone and metal bridge with railings and light masts spans the river, carrying pedestrians and possibly a tram or carriage. On the far bank are more houses and villas along a curving embankment. In the foreground there is a grassy slope with a simple wooden fence and leafless or sparsely leaved trees partially obscuring the town. The overall style and composition resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
